sources.title: Innovative Technologies Expand Research Capabilities in Alaska Marine Ecosystems
sources.outlet: NOAA Fisheries, Alaska Fisheries Science Center, last updated November 6th (agency, primary)
sources.note: The page that now says super intelligence for the seal, polar bear and otolith tools; machine learning survives in its heading and electronic monitoring line; no accuracy figures.

sources.title: Developing Artificial Intelligence To Find Ice Seals And Polar Bears From The Sky
sources.outlet: NOAA Fisheries feature story, October 17th, 2019, updated January 5th, 2024 (agency, primary)
sources.note: The same seal work described as artificial intelligence; 1,000 ft color and thermal; 7,000 to 9,000 animals per million images; two pixel seals; a year by hand; jury duty and a hackathon.

sources.title: Innovative technology helps scientists better estimate ages of long-lived rockfish
sources.outlet: NOAA Fisheries feature story, July 24th, 2024 (agency, primary)
sources.note: The rockfish aging work described as artificial intelligence and deep learning.

sources.title: Geospatial Analysis of Imagery for Animals (previously known as Geospatial Artificial Intelligence for Animals)
sources.outlet: NOAA Fisheries project page, updated November 6th (agency, primary)
sources.note: Whale detection from satellites, led by Northeast and Alaska Fisheries Science Centers; the page states its former name.
